sentences.en: A farewell party was held in honor of Mr Smith.
sentences.zh: 为史密斯先生举办的欢送会在校举行。

sentences.en: A farewell meeting was held in honor of Mr Jones.
sentences.zh: 为琼斯先生举行的告别会议如期召开。

sentences.en: We held a farewell party in honor of Dr. Kawamura.
sentences.zh: 我们为川村博士举办了一场欢送会。

senses.zh: 别了！（常含有永别或不容易再见面的意思）；再会！
